From: Elena Martinez <security@clearline.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Keystore handshake and rotation evidence request

Hi Aditya,

As part of ClearLine's SIG/SOC2 intake for the upcoming vendor audit, we need to collect encryption and key management evidence for Redwood-managed tenant keys used by our production environment. Can you provide the following: 

- HSM vendor attestation and firmware version for the HSM(s) used to wrap tenant KEKs (last attestation report and date).
- Operator/identity mapping for KMS rotation events for the past 24 months (operator ID, timestamp, rotation type).
- A sanitized extract of the key rotation logs (CSV preferred) with event IDs and SHA256 checksums.
- Sample envelope-wrapping headers (redacted) showing KEK wrapping algorithm and wrapping key id.
- Confirmation of in-transit protections for control and data planes (TLS versions/cipher suites and whether mTLS is used between services).

Target delivery: preferably by Tue 16 May so our audit can proceed on schedule. If any of these items require an NDA or redaction guidance, let me know.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Security Manager, ClearLine Health
security@clearline.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Martinez <security@clearline.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Keystore handshake and rotation evidence request

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested; a couple of clarifications so we scope correctly:

1) HSM attestation: we have a vendor-signed attestation (FIPS/HSM cert) and an operational attestation generated during our last rotation in 2027-11. Do you need the full vendor report or a derived statement for SIG?

2) Rotation logs: we can produce a sanitized CSV with operator IDs replaced by role-level tokens (e.g., ops-rotation-1) and supply a separate mapping under NDA if you require person-level mapping. Is role-level mapping sufficient for SIG?

3) Envelope headers: we will provide a 3-sample set with full algorithm identifiers and wrapped-key IDs (redacted where necessary).

4) TLS: control plane uses TLS 1.3; we can include the exact cipher suites and whether mutual TLS was enabled between specific services.

We will prepare a deliverable bundle and can upload to a shared Drive folder. Internal owners: looping in Irene (security/compliance) and Marissa (crypto ops) to assemble the artifacts. We expect to post the initial bundle by Thu 11 May and the operator mapping (if person-level) after an NDA is confirmed.

Attaching preliminary checklist (see later message for the actual artifacts).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
